I’ll inspect the span classes and serialization tests, then add copy and pickle support. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill and run focused tests without installing dependencies.
Immutable spans retain OpenTelemetry objects that contain locks. Lazy spans also trigger loading when Python looks up copy-related methods. I’ll serialize immutable spans through their dictionary representation, preserve attachments separately, and restore lazy spans without loading them or retaining duplicate raw JSON.
The code and regression tests are in place. The tests cover attachments, whole traces, loaded and unloaded lazy spans, shallow copies, and rejection of deep copy or pickle for live spans. The focused span and trace tests are running.
The first run failed because the environment configures an OTLP exporter with an unsupported `http/json` protocol, preventing span creation. I’m rerunning the same tests with those exporter settings unset for the test process.
The new regression tests pass with the exporter settings removed. The remaining tests in the span and trace files are still running; no code failures have appeared so far.
Implemented copy and pickle support for immutable, lazy, and no-op spans and whole traces, preserving attachments. Lazy spans restore unloaded without duplicate raw JSON. Shallow copies retain the underlying span; live spans reject deep copy and pickle with guidance to use `to_immutable_span()`.

Added regression tests. All 120 executed tests passed; one skipped. Pytest’s final reporting hook then hit a sandbox permission error while inspecting processes. No dependencies installed.

+from tests.tracing.helper import create_test_trace_info
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def immutable_span():
+    tracer = _get_tracer("test")
+    with tracer.start_as_current_span("parent"):
+        with tracer.start_as_current_span("child") as otel_span:
+            span = create_mlflow_span(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345", span_type=SpanType.LLM)
+            span.set_inputs({"input": [1, 2]})
+            span.set_outputs({"output": 3})
+            span.set_status(SpanStatus(SpanStatusCode.ERROR, "test error"))
+            span.add_event(SpanEvent("test_event", timestamp=123, attributes={"foo": "bar"}))
+            span.add_link(Link(trace_id="tr-abc123", span_id="aabbccddeeff0011"))
+    immutable = span.to_immutable_span()
+    attachment = Attachment(content_type="text/plain", content_bytes=b"test attachment")
+    immutable._attachments[attachment.id] = attachment
+    return immutable
+
+
+def pickle_round_trip(value):
+    return pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(value))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("span_kind", ["immutable", "lazy", "materialized_lazy"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("whole_trace", [False, True])
+def test_span_copy_and_pickle(immutable_span, restore, span_kind, whole_trace):
+    expected = immutable_span.to_dict()
+    span = immutable_span
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        span = LazySpan(expected, raw_json=json.dumps(expected))
+        if span_kind == "materialized_lazy":
+            assert span.name == "child"
+        span._attachments = immutable_span._attachments
+
+    original = (
+        Trace(create_test_trace_info("tr-12345"), TraceData(spans=[span])) if whole_trace else span
+    )
+    restored = restore(original)
+    assert restored is not original
+    if whole_trace:
+        assert restored.info == original.info
+        restored = restored.data.spans[0]
+
+    assert type(restored) is type(span)
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+        assert restored.__dict__["_raw_json"] is None
+        assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] == (span_kind == "materialized_lazy")
+        assert span.__dict__["_raw_json"] is not None
+        assert set(span.__getstate__()) == {"span_dict", "attachments"}
+
+    assert restored.to_dict() == expected
+    assert restored.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+    assert restored.outputs == {"output": 3}
+    assert restored.links == immutable_span.links
+    assert restored.events == immutable_span.events
+    assert restored.status == immutable_span.status
+    assert restored._span is not immutable_span._span
+    attachment_id = next(iter(span._attachments))
+    attachment = restored._attachments[attachment_id]
+    assert attachment is not span._attachments[attachment_id]
+    assert attachment.id == attachment_id
+    assert attachment.content_type == "text/plain"
+    assert attachment.content_bytes == b"test attachment"
+    restored.inputs["input"].append(4)
+    assert immutable_span.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+
+
+def test_span_shallow_copy(immutable_span):
+    restored = copy.copy(immutable_span)
+    assert restored is not immutable_span
+    assert restored._span is immutable_span._span
+    assert restored.to_dict() == immutable_span.to_dict()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+def test_live_span_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    with mlflow.start_span("live") as span:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"to_immutable_span\(\)"):
+            restore(span)
+        shallow = copy.copy(span)
+        assert shallow is not span
+        assert shallow._span is span._span
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+def test_no_op_span_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    span = NoOpSpan()
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert isinstance(restored, NoOpSpan)
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert restored.trace_id == span.trace_id
+    assert restored.name is None
+    assert restored.inputs is None
+    restored.set_inputs({"ignored": True})
+    assert restored.inputs is None
+

+def _sse(event):

+def _tool_use_stream(blocks):
+    """blocks: list of ("text", str) or ("tool", id, name, partial_json)."""
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {

+            delta = {"type": "text_delta", "text": block[1]}
+        else:
+            start = {"type": "tool_use", "id": block[1], "name": block[2], "input": {}}
+            delta = {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": block[3]}
+        events += [
+            {"type": "content_block_start", "index": i, "content_block": start},
+            {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": i, "delta": delta},
+            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": i},
